Embryonic pole >5 mm or hCG >2000 mIU/mL or LMP >35 days past
Diagnosis certain: Help patient choose appropriate management (see and )
Diagnosis not certain: Serial hCG (every 48 hours) or repeat ultrasound (weekly) until diagnosis is certain
Fetal heart rate observed. Hear rate normal (100-160 bpm)?
Routine prenatal care and reevaluate if presenting symptoms persist
Risk of early pregnancy failure is elevated
Diagnosis not certain: Serial HCG (every 48 hours) or repeat ultrasound (weekly) until diagnosis is certain
